Hi Sean,

We're reviewing our vendor evidence packet for an upcoming audit and noticed Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report ends on 2026-06-30. Our compliance team asks for an interim attestation or bridge letter that covers the period from 2026-07-01 to present (we expect our submission window will be early August). Specifically, they need:

- A short statement confirming whether there have been any material control changes since the report end date that would affect security or availability controls;
- If there were changes, a brief explanation and any compensating controls; or
- If an independent interim attestation is available (limited-scope review), a timeline and sample language.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? We can accept either: (a) a formal bridge letter signed by your security lead, or (b) a limited interim attestation if you offer that service. Our procurement contact (procurement@everguardhealth.com) will handle any acceptance or PO.
